policies.title: Statutory Disclaimer
policies.content:
WeGro Finance is registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) as a Research Analyst under Registration No. INH000014289. Research reports, market commentaries, and advisory materials published by WeGro Finance are prepared for informational and advisory purposes only and do not constitute an offer to buy or sell securities.

Securities investments are subject to market risks including loss of principal. WeGro Finance does not guarantee returns or capital preservation under any circumstances.

policies.title: SEBI Mandatory Disclosures
policies.content:
Disclosures pursuant to SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014:
1. The Research Analyst or associates or relatives do not have any financial interest in the subject company.
2. The Research Analyst or associates do not have actual/beneficial ownership of 1% or more securities of the subject company at the end of the month immediately preceding the publication date.
3. Neither WeGro Finance nor its analysts have received any compensation from the subject company for investment banking or merchant banking services in the preceding twelve months.

policies.title: Terms & Conditions of Service
policies.content: By subscribing to or using the research services provided by WeGro Finance, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. All content provided is proprietary and meant exclusively for the registered subscriber. Distribution, reproduction, or commercial dissemination of research reports without prior written consent is strictly prohibited and subject to legal action under applicable Indian laws.

policies.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
policies.content: WeGro Finance complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP) and SEBI cybersecurity frameworks. We collect personal information (name, contact details, PAN, and KYC identifiers) solely for fulfilling statutory compliance and delivering advisory services. Investor data is encrypted in transit and at rest and is never sold to third parties.

policies.title: Investor Charter for Research Analysts
policies.content:
A. Vision and Mission Statements for Investors:
- Vision: Invest with knowledge & safety.
- Mission: Every investor should be treated with fairness and transparency.

B. Rights of Investors:
- Right to receive authentic, unconflicted research recommendations.
- Right to clear disclosures of risk factors and analyst holdings.
- Right to timely grievance redressal through SCORES and SMART ODR.

policies.title: Risk Warning: Short-Term Investments & Trading
policies.content: Trading in cash equities, derivatives, or short-term momentum setups carries significant risk of capital depletion. Historical performance does not guarantee future results. As per SEBI studies, 9 out of 10 individual traders in the equity F&O segment incurred net losses. Clients must strictly determine whether short-term trading is suitable in light of their personal financial condition and risk tolerance.
